title: Do you ever live in random suburban houses with other people?
content: Sometimes after i come back from the city, i end up walking toward a neighborhood that borders the desert region in my mallworld and usually I'm living in one of these abandoned-like homes with a bunch of other people. Like i have my own room but they all live everywhere else in the house, even the bathroom. This scenario has happened to me 3 times this past week in mallworld so i felt like mentioning it. The feeling of the house is always like it has been "mine" for awhile but these people are also welcome in it even if i dont know them. Its just slightly annoying and overwhelming when i first show up, it reminds me of a block party but it isnt crazy. Everyone just stands around, talks, cooks, normal stuff.
